name: Oil Shock
description: A major oil-producing region is destabilized, sending energy prices soaring and threatening global economic stability

phases.name: Geopolitical Crisis
headlines: Major oil-producing region destabilized — crude surges 25% overnight
Military conflict threatens key oil shipping routes — energy stocks spike
Strategic petroleum reserves tapped as oil supply disruption escalates
phases.summary: A sudden geopolitical crisis in a major oil-producing region sends crude prices surging as markets price in severe supply disruption. Governments begin tapping strategic reserves.

phases.name: Oil Price Doubles
headlines: Oil hits $200/barrel as supply disruption exceeds worst-case scenarios
Airlines and shipping companies warn of service cuts as fuel costs explode
Transportation stocks crash 20% — consumer discretionary follows
phases.summary: Oil prices double as the supply disruption proves far worse than initially feared. Transportation and airline stocks crash while energy companies surge. Consumer spending outlook darkens.

phases.name: Diplomatic Resolution
headlines: Breakthrough diplomatic deal reached — oil supply restoration begins
Crude prices drop 30% on ceasefire agreement and supply guarantees
Markets rally broadly as oil shock fears recede after diplomatic breakthrough
phases.summary: A diplomatic breakthrough resolves the crisis faster than expected. Oil supply restoration begins immediately, sending crude prices sharply lower and triggering a broad market relief rally.

phases.name: War Premium Persists
headlines: Conflict escalates — oil supply disruption now expected to last months
Stagflation fears grip markets as $200 oil becomes the new normal
Central banks face impossible choice: fight inflation or support collapsing growth
phases.summary: The conflict escalates with no resolution in sight. Markets price in sustained $200 oil, triggering stagflation fears as central banks face the impossible choice between fighting inflation and supporting growth.

phases.name: Demand Destruction
headlines: Global recession fears crush oil demand — prices collapse below pre-crisis levels
Oil crashes from $200 to $40 as economic activity plummets worldwide
Energy stocks reverse gains as demand destruction overwhelms supply concerns
phases.summary: The oil shock triggers such severe economic damage that demand destruction overwhelms the supply disruption. Oil crashes below pre-crisis levels as a global recession takes hold.

phases.name: Recovery Underway
headlines: Oil markets normalize as full supply restored — economic damage limited
Markets recover to pre-crisis levels as oil shock proves temporary
Transportation and airline stocks lead recovery as fuel costs normalize
phases.summary: Full oil supply restoration and normalizing prices allow the economy to recover quickly. The oil shock proves to be a temporary disruption with limited lasting damage.

phases.name: Stagflation Deepens
headlines: Economy enters stagflation — rising inflation with falling growth
Consumer spending collapses as energy costs consume household budgets
Fed raises rates despite recession — 'inflation is the greater threat'
phases.summary: Full stagflation takes hold with rising inflation and falling growth. Consumer spending collapses as energy costs consume household budgets and the Fed is forced to raise rates into a recession.

phases.name: Deep Recession
headlines: Global GDP contracts sharply — worst recession since 2008
Energy sector devastated as oil languishes at $35 despite supply disruption
Massive fiscal stimulus packages announced worldwide to combat recession
phases.summary: A deep global recession takes hold as the demand destruction spiral accelerates. Governments respond with massive fiscal stimulus but economic recovery is expected to take years.

phases.name: Energy Transition Accelerates
headlines: Oil shock accelerates renewable energy investment — 'never again' consensus forms
Post-crisis energy policy shifts dramatically toward diversification
phases.summary: The oil shock serves as a catalyst for accelerated energy transition investment. A political consensus forms around energy diversification to prevent future supply shocks.

phases.name: Prolonged Economic Pain
headlines: Stagflation persists — markets see no catalyst for recovery in near term
Oil-dependent economies face sovereign debt crises as fiscal positions deteriorate
phases.summary: Stagflation persists with no clear catalyst for recovery. Oil-dependent economies face sovereign debt crises as prolonged high energy prices erode fiscal positions globally.

phases.name: Stimulus-Driven Recovery
headlines: Massive stimulus begins lifting economy from recession — slow but steady recovery
Oil prices normalize as supply and demand gradually rebalance
phases.summary: The combination of massive fiscal stimulus and normalizing oil prices begins pulling the global economy out of recession. Recovery is slow but steady.

name: Bank Run / Liquidity Crisis
description: Social media rumors trigger a modern bank run that threatens to cascade into a full-blown liquidity crisis across the financial system

phases.name: Social Media Panic
headlines: Viral social media posts trigger deposit flight at major bank — $30B withdrawn in hours
Bank stock crashes 40% as customers line up at branches demanding cash
Modern bank run: smartphone-enabled withdrawals drain deposits at unprecedented speed
phases.summary: Viral social media rumors about a major bank's solvency trigger the first smartphone-enabled bank run. Deposits flee at unprecedented speed as customers withdraw $30B in hours.

phases.name: Contagion Spreads
headlines: Contagion spreads — three more banks report unusual withdrawal activity
Fed calls emergency meeting as interbank lending market freezes
Financial stocks plunge 25% as investors fear systemic banking crisis
phases.summary: The bank run spreads to multiple institutions as depositors lose confidence in the banking system. The Fed calls an emergency meeting as the interbank lending market freezes completely.

phases.name: Fed Backstop
headlines: Fed announces unlimited deposit guarantee — 'all deposits are safe'
Emergency lending facility calms markets — bank stocks stage dramatic reversal
Treasury Secretary: 'The full faith and credit of the United States stands behind every deposit'
phases.summary: The Fed announces an unprecedented unlimited deposit guarantee backed by the full faith of the US government. Emergency lending facilities restore interbank confidence and bank stocks stage a dramatic V-shaped reversal.

phases.name: Controlled Unwind
headlines: Regulators seize failing bank — arrange orderly sale to larger institution
Two mid-size banks merged into larger rivals under FDIC supervision
Banking sector stabilizing but credit conditions tightening sharply
phases.summary: Regulators engineer a controlled unwind, seizing the original failing bank and arranging mergers for other stressed institutions. The crisis is contained but credit conditions tighten significantly.

phases.name: Full Panic
headlines: Multiple bank failures overwhelm FDIC — government scrambles for emergency funding
Credit markets freeze completely — corporations unable to access working capital
Stock market crashes 15% in single week as financial system seizes
phases.summary: The crisis spirals beyond control as multiple simultaneous bank failures overwhelm the FDIC. Credit markets freeze completely, cutting off corporate access to working capital and triggering a broad market crash.

phases.name: V-Shaped Recovery
headlines: Banking sector fully recovered — Fed backstop proved decisive
Deposit flows normalize as confidence returns to financial system
Financial stocks rally past pre-crisis levels on renewed confidence
phases.summary: The Fed's decisive backstop proves effective as deposit flows normalize and confidence returns. Financial stocks rally past pre-crisis levels in a textbook V-shaped recovery.

phases.name: Credit Crunch
headlines: Surviving banks slash lending — credit crunch hits small businesses hardest
Economic growth slows sharply as tight credit conditions persist
Banking consolidation wave creates 'too big to fail' concerns
phases.summary: Surviving banks dramatically reduce lending, creating a credit crunch that hits small businesses hardest. Economic growth slows as tight credit conditions persist for months.

phases.name: Emergency Bailout
headlines: Congress passes $500B emergency bank bailout package after all-night session
Taxpayer-funded bailout stabilizes system but sparks massive political backlash
Credit markets slowly thaw as government guarantees take effect
phases.summary: Congress passes a massive $500B emergency bailout package after an all-night session. The financial system stabilizes but the taxpayer-funded rescue sparks enormous political backlash.

phases.name: New Regulatory Framework
headlines: Sweeping bank regulation reform enacted to prevent future social media-driven runs
Financial sector enters new era of stability under enhanced oversight
phases.summary: New regulatory frameworks are enacted specifically designed to prevent social media-driven bank runs. The financial sector enters a new era of enhanced oversight and stability.

phases.name: Slow Healing
headlines: Banking sector slowly normalizes — lending standards remain elevated
Small business lending still 30% below pre-crisis levels one year later
phases.summary: The banking sector slowly heals but elevated lending standards persist. Small business lending remains well below pre-crisis levels, creating a drag on economic growth.

phases.name: Political Fallout
headlines: Bank bailout becomes defining political issue — 'never again' legislation drafted
Financial sector faces decade of punitive regulation after taxpayer rescue
phases.summary: The bank bailout becomes the defining political issue, leading to punitive regulatory legislation. The financial sector faces a decade of restrictive oversight as the political fallout reshapes policy.

name: Natural Catastrophe
description: A massive natural disaster strikes a major economic hub, disrupting supply chains, crushing insurance stocks, and triggering a rebuilding boom

phases.name: Disaster Strikes
headlines: Catastrophic natural disaster devastates major economic hub — damage in hundreds of billions
Worst natural disaster in a generation shuts down critical infrastructure
Markets brace for impact as scale of destruction becomes clear
phases.summary: A catastrophic natural disaster strikes a major economic hub causing hundreds of billions in damage. Critical infrastructure is destroyed and the full scale of devastation shocks markets.

phases.name: Economic Fallout
headlines: Insurance stocks crash 30% as catastrophe loss estimates keep rising
Supply chain disruptions spread globally — factories worldwide forced to halt production
Construction and industrial stocks surge as rebuilding demand priced in
phases.summary: Insurance companies face catastrophic losses while supply chain disruptions ripple globally. Construction and industrial stocks surge on anticipated rebuilding demand while the broader market sells off on economic uncertainty.

phases.name: Quick Recovery
headlines: Rebuilding efforts exceed expectations — economic activity surging in disaster zone
Insurance industry absorbs losses better than feared — reinsurance holds
Supply chains rerouted successfully — global production disruption limited
phases.summary: The recovery proves faster than expected as rebuilding efforts surge and supply chains are successfully rerouted. Insurance industry absorbs the losses without systemic stress.

phases.name: Prolonged Disruption
headlines: Secondary disasters compound original damage — recovery timeline extends years
Major insurer fails under weight of catastrophe claims — contagion fears emerge
Supply chain disruptions far worse than expected — global manufacturing in crisis
phases.summary: Secondary disasters and compounding failures extend the crisis. A major insurer collapses under claims and supply chain disruptions prove far more severe than anticipated, threatening global manufacturing.

phases.name: Rebuilding Boom
headlines: Disaster zone rebuilding drives construction boom — industrial stocks at all-time highs
Insurance premiums surge but industry stabilizes — reinsurers raise capital
GDP boosted by massive reconstruction spending — silver lining emerges
phases.summary: A massive rebuilding boom drives construction and industrial stocks to record highs. Insurance premiums surge but the industry stabilizes as reinsurers raise fresh capital.

phases.name: Economic Zone Abandoned
headlines: Major companies permanently relocate operations away from disaster zone
Economists warn affected region may never fully recover — 'economic dead zone'
Insurance industry in crisis — multiple firms face solvency concerns
phases.summary: Major companies permanently abandon the disaster zone, creating an economic dead zone. Multiple insurance firms face solvency concerns as the industry struggles to absorb unprecedented losses.

phases.name: New Normal
headlines: Rebuilt infrastructure stronger and more resilient — disaster zone modernized
Markets fully recovered — disaster now seen as temporary disruption
phases.summary: The rebuilt infrastructure is stronger and more resilient than before. Markets have fully recovered as the disaster is viewed in hindsight as a temporary disruption that ultimately drove modernization.

phases.name: Long-Term Scars
headlines: Insurance industry permanently reprices catastrophe risk — premiums double industry-wide
Climate risk repricing sends shockwaves through real estate and infrastructure valuations
phases.summary: The catastrophe permanently reprices disaster risk across insurance, real estate, and infrastructure. The long-term economic scars reshape how markets value climate and catastrophe exposure.

name: Dollar Reserve Crisis
description: The US dollar's reserve currency status comes under existential threat as major economies coordinate a shift to alternative settlement systems, triggering a monetary earthquake

phases.name: Dollar Shock
headlines: Major oil exporters announce non-dollar settlement — USD plunges 8% in hours
BRICS nations unveil alternative payment system backed by commodity basket
Dollar index crashes to 20-year low as reserve currency status questioned
phases.summary: A coordinated announcement by major oil-exporting nations that they will settle trades in non-dollar currencies sends the greenback into freefall. The BRICS alternative payment system gains instant credibility, shaking the foundation of dollar dominance.

phases.name: Reserve Reallocation
headlines: Central banks diversify away from dollar at record pace — $2T in reserves shifted
Treasury yields spike as foreign demand for US debt collapses
Gold surges past $5,000 as central banks hoard alternative reserve assets
phases.summary: Central banks worldwide begin diversifying reserves away from the dollar at unprecedented speed. Demand for US Treasuries collapses, sending yields spiking. Gold and alternative reserve assets surge as the global monetary order fractures.

phases.name: Dollar Stabilizes
headlines: Fed acts decisively with massive rate hike — 'we will defend the dollar'
Allied nations reaffirm dollar commitment — NATO economic solidarity declaration
Dollar bounces sharply as geopolitical allies rally behind reserve currency status
phases.summary: The Fed responds with an emergency rate hike and allied nations issue a joint declaration reaffirming the dollar's central role. The coordinated response stabilizes the currency and Treasury demand recovers as the initial panic subsides.

phases.name: Multipolar Currency
headlines: Gradual shift to currency basket accelerates — dollar share of reserves drops below 50%
IMF proposes expanded SDR basket as neutral settlement currency
US trade deficit balloons as dollar weakness drives import costs higher
phases.summary: A gradual but irreversible shift to a multipolar currency system takes hold. The dollar's share of global reserves drops below 50% for the first time. The IMF proposes an expanded SDR basket as the new neutral settlement mechanism.

phases.name: Dollar Panic
headlines: US Treasury auction fails for first time in history — no buyers at offered yields
Emergency rate hike of 200bps fails to stem capital flight from dollar assets
Dollar crashes 20% against major currencies — import prices explode overnight
phases.summary: A US Treasury auction fails for the first time in history as foreign buyers refuse to participate. Emergency rate hikes fail to stem capital flight. The dollar crashes 20%, causing import prices to explode and triggering an immediate cost-of-living crisis.

phases.name: Dollar Hegemony Preserved
headlines: Dollar rebounds to pre-crisis levels as allied economic bloc solidifies
BRICS payment system loses momentum as technical and political divisions emerge
US fiscal discipline pledge restores long-term confidence in dollar assets
phases.summary: The coordinated defense of the dollar succeeds. The BRICS alternative falters due to internal divisions and technical limitations. A US pledge of fiscal discipline and allied solidarity restores long-term confidence in dollar-denominated assets.

phases.name: New Currency Order
headlines: Global trade increasingly settled in regional currency blocs — dollar era fading
US multinationals face permanent headwind from structurally weaker dollar
Emerging market currencies surge as multipolar system redistributes monetary power
phases.summary: A new multipolar currency order takes shape with regional currency blocs handling most trade settlement. US multinationals face a permanent currency headwind while emerging market economies gain monetary sovereignty.

phases.name: Emergency Stabilization
headlines: G7 emergency summit produces coordinated currency intervention — largest in history
Fed swap lines extended globally as central banks cooperate to prevent monetary collapse
Dollar stabilizes at 30% below pre-crisis level — 'new normal' pricing accepted
phases.summary: A G7 emergency summit produces the largest coordinated currency intervention in history. The dollar stabilizes but at a permanently lower level. The US must accept a diminished monetary role in exchange for system stability.

phases.name: New Monetary Order
headlines: Post-crisis monetary landscape permanently altered — multi-currency world emerges
Dollar remains important but no longer dominant — era of 'exorbitant privilege' ends
Markets adapt to new monetary reality with permanently higher currency volatility
phases.summary: Regardless of which path the crisis took, the global monetary order is permanently altered. The dollar remains a major currency but its unquestioned dominance is over. Markets adapt to a new reality of higher currency volatility and diversified reserves.

name: Derivatives Blowup
description: A shadow banking derivatives explosion triggers a CDO/CDS crisis 2.0 as hidden counterparty exposure threatens to bring down the entire financial system

phases.name: Hidden Exposure
headlines: Major bank reveals $500B in unreported derivative losses — stock halted immediately
Auditors discover massive off-balance-sheet derivative positions hidden for years
Regulators blindsided by scale of undisclosed derivatives exposure at systemically important bank
phases.summary: A systemically important bank shocks the world by revealing $500 billion in previously unreported derivative losses. The positions were hidden through complex off-balance-sheet structures that evaded regulatory oversight for years.

phases.name: Counterparty Panic
headlines: Banks refuse to trade with each other — interbank rates spike 500bps overnight
CDS spreads on major banks explode as counterparty exposure fears grip markets
LIBOR replacement rates surge as trust evaporates from the financial system
phases.summary: Banks refuse to trade with each other as nobody knows who else has hidden derivative exposure. Interbank lending rates spike 500 basis points overnight. The financial system's plumbing freezes as counterparty fear paralyzes all activity.

phases.name: Transparency Fix
headlines: Emergency disclosure mandates force all banks to reveal derivative positions within 72 hours
Regulators coordinate orderly unwind of toxic positions — worst fears not realized
Exposure concentrated in three institutions — rest of system healthier than feared
phases.summary: Regulators mandate emergency disclosure of all derivative positions within 72 hours. The resulting transparency reveals that toxic exposure is concentrated in just three institutions rather than being systemic. An orderly unwind begins.

phases.name: Cascade Default
headlines: First counterparty default triggers chain reaction — five banks face insolvency within days
Derivative netting agreements fail as multiple counterparties default simultaneously
Credit markets in complete freefall — corporate bond spreads hit crisis levels
phases.summary: The first counterparty default triggers a chain reaction as derivative netting agreements — designed for isolated failures — collapse under simultaneous defaults. Five major banks face insolvency within days as the cascade accelerates.

phases.name: Shadow Bank Run
headlines: Non-bank financial institutions face funding crisis as repo markets freeze
Shadow banking sector — $50T in assets — faces existential liquidity crisis
Insurance companies, pension funds, and asset managers scramble for cash as derivatives unwind
phases.summary: The crisis spreads beyond banks into the shadow banking system. Insurance companies, pension funds, and asset managers discover they are counterparties to the toxic derivatives. The $50 trillion shadow banking sector faces an existential funding crisis.

phases.name: Contained Cleanup
headlines: Three exposed banks recapitalized with private sector funds — no taxpayer bailout needed
Derivative positions unwound over 90 days — losses painful but manageable
Financial stocks recover as systemic risk proves contained to identified institutions
phases.summary: The three exposed institutions are recapitalized through private sector investment. Derivative positions are unwound over 90 days in an orderly process. The crisis proves painful but manageable once transparency is established.

phases.name: Government Takeover
headlines: Government nationalizes three failing banks — largest state intervention in financial history
Taxpayer cost of derivatives cleanup estimated at $800B — public fury erupts
Criminal investigations launched against bank executives who hid derivative exposure
phases.summary: The government is forced to nationalize three failing banks in the largest state intervention in financial history. The taxpayer cost is estimated at $800 billion, triggering massive public anger and criminal investigations against bank executives.

phases.name: Systemic Rescue
headlines: Fed and Treasury launch $2T combined rescue of banking and shadow banking systems
Emergency legislation grants regulators power over all derivative-holding institutions
Global coordinated intervention prevents total financial system collapse — barely
phases.summary: A $2 trillion combined Fed-Treasury rescue package prevents total financial system collapse. Emergency legislation extends regulatory authority over all derivative-holding institutions including shadow banks. The system survives, but barely.

phases.name: Derivatives Reform
headlines: Sweeping derivatives reform mandates central clearing and real-time position reporting
OTC derivatives market permanently transformed — all trades must go through clearinghouses
New era of financial transparency begins — 'never again' legislation enacted
phases.summary: Comprehensive derivatives reform mandates central clearing, real-time position reporting, and the elimination of off-balance-sheet derivative structures. The OTC derivatives market is permanently transformed with a focus on transparency and systemic safety.
